projects.name: Flickering Flames
projects.description: A festival of resilient warmth, centered around the hardy candleberry bush. Speranzans have been known to host local celebrations, and being competitive, they seek to outdo each other at every turn. Some have managed to turn the homely candleberry bush into a banquet worthy of even the most discerning gourmands.

phases.name: Candlelight
phases.description: The namesake use for the candleberry, Speranzans boil the fruit into a thick wax that burns cleanly and fragrantly.

phases.name: Decorations
phases.description: Many Speranzans have become surprisingly adept at the art of bringing beauty and greenery into the home.

phases.name: Presents
phases.description: Crafty Speranzans have turned the candleberries into a wealth of gifts. These include perfumes and soaps, as well as gifts unrelated to the recipient's odors.

phases.name: Beverages
phases.description: Candleberries can be crushed into refreshing juices, while the leaves and roots make for a tea that can drive out the toughest of colds.

phases.name: Meals
phases.description: Though candleberry leaves are bitter, simmering them in stew and soups adds a touch of earthiness that nostalgic Speranzans have grown to love.

projects.name: Weather Monitor System
projects.description: Collect the required parts to build a private weather station, and help monitor the turbulent weather above.

phases.name: Atmospheric pressure
phases.description: Lets you measure if that heavy weight on your shoulders is actually just the air.

phases.name: Sunlight
phases.description: Sunlight might be sparse in Speranza, but ultraviolet rays can still be measured by the right equipment.

phases.name: Precipitation
phases.description: Very few parts of Speranza are completely waterproof. Now you can say it’s for science.

phases.name: Humidity
phases.description: Great for keeping your skin looking luminous, and your walls somewhat moldy.

phases.name: Temperature
phases.description: Significantly more accurate than counting shivers per minute.

projects.name: High-Gain Antenna
projects.description: When placed in open areas, these parabolic dishes can pick up on distant signals within a narrow beamwidth, which may help triangulate the origins of the troubling ARC signals that were recently reported.

phases.name: Sturdy Base
phases.description: An extra-sturdy base that can withstand anything from bitter winds to sudden cloudbursts.

phases.name: Data Logger
phases.description: A closed-circuit interface to monitor and analyze distributed data points over time.

phases.name: Parabolic Dish
phases.description: A custom-built parabolic dish designed to capture distant signals in even the most stormy of conditions.
